title: Funds get locked in the vault
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  In case:  - User X requests to redeem shares for assets and set `receiver` for Y - Agent Z registered in the Dynamic Account of user X will remove liquidity from Uniswap V3 - Agent Z calls `OmoVault.sol#topOff()` function.  But the current implementation will revert in the above case.
